curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Having already seen how badly the revival process can go, can his desperate attempt to restore the girl he loves result in anything but catastrophe?
curatedMovie.description: After his girlfriend dies in a sudden motorcycle crash, a devastated teenager uses a top-secret reanimation experiment he recently witnessed to bring her back, setting off a horrific chain of events.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Heavy, suspenseful horror romance with steady pacing and intense emotional grief.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: This horror romance follows a teenager who turns a secret project to revive the dead toward saving his girlfriend.

facts.title: Return of the Living Dead III
